title: krn task edit rewrites a pending record instead of calling it archived
body:
Source: lead session 2026-11-16: `krn task edit t-1nkf30z --body-file ...` and `--append-body` on a record created in the main checkout (pending on refs/krn/pending-tasks, #1201) exit 65 "tasks/t-1nkf30z.json: task is archived and read-only; create a new task instead", while `krn task show t-1nkf30z` reads it as open.
Outcome: `krn task edit` on a pending record rewrites it on the pending ref and exits 0; `krn task show` prints the edited body; a closed archived record still refuses with exit 65.
Proof: a test in test/task/ creates a record in a main-checkout fixture, edits its body and asserts the pending ref holds the edit, plus the archived refusal.
Files: src/task/
